mapper.sql: id, batch_key AS batchKey, item_count AS itemCount, fail_every AS failEvery, fail_times AS failTimes, status, generated_execution_id AS generatedExecutionId, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, completed_at AS completedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xxl_learning_batch ( batch_key, item_count, fail_every, fail_times, status, generated_execution_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{batchKey}, #{itemCount}, #{failEvery}, #{failTimes}, 'READY', #{generatedExecutionId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (batch_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM xxl_learning_batch WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: WITH counts AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'RETRY_WAIT')) AS active_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'RETRY_WAIT') AS retry_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SUCCESS') AS success_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'DEAD') AS dead_count FROM xxl_learning_work_item WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} ) UPDATE xxl_learning_batch target SET status = CASE WHEN counts.active_count > 0 AND counts.retry_count > 0 THEN 'RETRY_WAIT' WHEN counts.active_count > 0 THEN 'PROCESSING' WHEN counts.dead_count = 0 THEN 'SUCCESS' WHEN counts.success_count = 0 THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS' END, completed_at = CASE WHEN counts.active_count = 0 THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM counts WHERE target.id = #{batchId}
mapper.select: WITH counts AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'RETRY_WAIT')) AS active_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'RETRY_WAIT') AS retry_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SUCCESS') AS success_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'DEAD') AS dead_count FROM xxl_learning_work_item WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} ) UPDATE xxl_learning_batch target SET status = CASE WHEN counts.active_count > 0 AND counts.retry_count > 0 THEN 'RETRY_WAIT' WHEN counts.active_count > 0 THEN 'PROCESSING' WHEN counts.dead_count = 0 THEN 'SUCCESS' WHEN counts.success_count = 0 THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS' END, completed_at = CASE WHEN counts.active_count = 0 THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM counts WHERE target.id = #{batchId} RETURNING
